Specifications.Network Media:
• 10BASE-T: UTP category 3, 4, 5 cable (maximum 100m)
• EIA/TIA-568 100Ω STP (maximum 100m)
• 100BASE-TX: UTP category 5, 5e cable (maximum 100m)
• EIA/TIA-568 100Ω STP (maximum 100m)
Specifications.External Power Supply: External Power Adapter (Output: 54 V DC / 1.3 A)
Specifications.PoE Ports (RJ45):
• Standard: 802.3 af/at compliant
• PoE Ports: Ports 1–4
• Power Supply: 67 W
Specifications.Max. Power Consumption:
• 1.9 W (with no PD connected)
• 74 W (with 67 W PD connected)
Specifications.Max. Heat Dissipation:
• 6.5 BTU/h(with no PD connected)
• 252.3 BTU/h(with 67 W PD connected)
Specifications.Advanced Features:
• Compatible with IEEE 802.3af/at compliant power devices (PDs)
• Extend mode switch (Ports 1–4)
• Priority mode switch (Ports 1–2)
• MAC address auto-learning and auto-aging
• IEEE802.3x flow control for full-duplex mode and backpressure for half-duplex mode
